notes: §2002:14.8.4.3 GR7: without NESTED, program-prototype-name-1 (or a restricted program-pointer's prototype) determines the called program's characteristics; COBOL-2002 asks no agreement of the two prototypes, a rule first stated by §2014:14.9.4.2 SR14. CallBinder.Identifier1Screen asks the SR14 screen (COBOL2936) only where DialectBehavior.CallRestrictedPointerSignatureSame is active (VCR row 7.121, from 2014), so CALL PA AS G2RPAB with PA restricted to a prototype of another signature compiles at --std 2002 and passes WS-N by reference to the held program (N=0008); refused from 2014 (pb609-call-restricted-program-pointer-signature) (PB5714).
